query: SELECT held.ok AS "held!",(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT FROM upload_sessions WHERE held.ok AND id=ANY($1) ORDER BY id FOR NO KEY UPDATE) locked) AS locked FROM (SELECT COALESCE(bool_and(pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(key,0))),TRUE) AS ok FROM (SELECT DISTINCT 'upload:'||id AS key FROM UNNEST($1::text[]) AS id ORDER BY key OFFSET 0) ordered) held
